title: Complete and standardise the reference list
requirements:
- Provide the consolidated reference list now, covering every in-text citation
- Apply one citation style, moving URLs out of the body
- Prefer primary, authoritative sources and cite sources that support each country claim specifically
- Distinguish normative references, with exact versions, from informative ones
- Give source, licence and adaptation statement for each adapted figure
- Add authoritative sources for privacy, security, accessibility, clinical safety and AI
- Record versions and dates, especially for evolving standards
- Review for geographic and income-level balance
